limitations: Nominal OD series is based on ISO 4427-2:2019 Table 1, from 16 mm through 3000 mm.
SDR series and grade-specific PN mapping follow ISO 4427-2:2019 Table 2 and Amendment 1:2023 reference.
Only grade/SDR/OD combinations represented in the dimensional table ranges are included; unsupported combinations are omitted.

Except retained PE100/PE80 SDR11 values for OD 32–630 mm, nominal wall thicknesses are generated from OD/SDR, rounded to 0.1 mm and subject to minimum wall thickness rules. They are not a transcription of every Table 2 entry and must be verified against a controlled standard before design.
The SDR11 OD 20 mm wall is corrected to the 2.0 mm Table 2 minimum reference.
PN values are reference values at the standard reference conditions; temperature derating, design coefficient and project requirements must be checked.
For OD >= 900 mm, maximum out-of-roundness requirements need special agreement/checking.
This dataset does not include full e_max tolerances, minimum bore, ovality, manufacturer availability or all national deviations.

Manufacturer-specific PE100 catalogue records are stored separately in databases/manufacturer_catalogues/gf_pe100_water_2022.json; they must not be interpreted as universal ISO availability or substituted for controlled standard dimensions.
